sources.title: GitHub - RoboDojo-Benchmark/RoboDojo: RoboDojo Official Repo
sources.snippet: RoboDojo is eval-only in this release: it provides the simulator client, benchmark tasks, asset/config validation, and result artifacts. Policy integration and policy servers are owned by XPolicyLab. 🌐 Unified sim-and-real benchmark — 42 simulation tasks and 18 real-world tasks across 3 robot embodiments for generalist robot manipulation.

sources.snippet: Auto multi-GPU grouping robodojo.sh smoke and robodojo.sh benchmark now support balanced multi-GPU execution driven by the runtime table in ../optimal_8group.txt. Pass a concrete GPU id list and RoboDojo will partition the selected tasks online instead of relying on a hard-coded task group.

sources.title: RoboDojo: A Unified Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Comprehensive Evaluation ...
sources.snippet: RoboDojo is a unified sim-and-real benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of generalist robot manipulation policies, with 42 simulation tasks, 18 real-world tasks, and a public leaderboard.
